decisions.reason: Current official College of Business and Computing and Management page expressly identify Management as a Bachelor of Business Administration major. No separately constituted Management department is established by the imported label; generic business/process leadership is not converted into an Operations unit.

sources.note: Read full current College of Business and Computing overview, all business/computing undergraduate majors and graduate/certificate offerings. Management is listed as undergraduate major; Department of Computing explicitly exists separately. Generic AACSB description about bachelor’s/master’s/doctoral business schools is accreditation background, not evidence GSW awards PhDs.

Read full BBA in Management page, programme details, degree level, careers and college context. Management is expressly a degree major. Curriculum link is an XLSX and was not opened/read in Chrome; no course-level scope claimed from that file.
Read full Graduate Admissions page and all three current graduate provider categories: Business and Computing, Nursing, Education; followed the observed All Graduate Programs inventory link.

Read full undergraduate programme panel, then selected Graduate and read the entire graduate panel. Graduate awards: MBA, MEd fields, Education Specialist fields, MS Computer Science and MSN fields. No doctoral row. Undergraduate pre-engineering explicitly Regents’ Engineering Pathway, not direct doctorate.

Read full displayed MBA overview/programme details and admission overview. Broad business simulation in global manufacturing context does not establish a distinct Ops department or research doctorate. Collapsed admissions detail not expanded; curriculum XLSX not read.

limitations: Management is verified as a major rather than a separate department. Detailed curriculum spreadsheets were not reviewed; no exhaustive claim about all Operations teaching in the college.
No research doctorate is listed in the full current institutional Graduate panel; generic AACSB wording about doctoral business schools is not institutional award evidence.
